pandas.read_clipboard

pandas 3.1.1 · Input and output · function

Parse delimited text from the system clipboard into a DataFrame.

  • Call syntax
  • Inspect the call
  • Parameters
  • Returns

Call syntax

pd.read_clipboard(sep='\\s+', dtype_backend=…, **kwargs)

Inspect the call

Run this code to inspect the callable and its parameters. Its data, backend, or environment is needed to execute the operation itself.

Returns

Example for a local Python session
import pandas as pd
# Copy a tab-delimited table with a header to your clipboard before running.
orders = pd.read_clipboard(sep="	")
print(orders.head())
